method: Every EV id cited anywhere in packs/product-discovery/ was read back from registry/evidence.json. No source was re-fetched and no licence was inferred: licence_state is derived from the ledger row's own licence text and from whether that row carries a licence_evidence line. Carried expression was checked by reading the pack's read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, guides, refs, exemplars) and by scanning every quoted span in it.

carried_expression.note: Two quoted spans of six words or more in the read surface, both the pack's own illustrative questions in WG-DISC-002 rather than source text. Findings are restated in the pack's own words throughout and the numeric claims are attributed to their EV ids. No table, list or figure is carried from a source.
